name: lvirify
description: Office now-playing cassette wall: hub (Raspberry Pi) + per-colleague companion that broadcasts Spotify to the wall and to Slack status.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/clients && npm run build -w packages/dashboard && npm run build -w packages/hub && npm run build -w packages/companion
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/clients
scripts.dev:hub: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w packages/hub
scripts.dev:dashboard: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w packages/dashboard
scripts.dev:companion: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w packages/companion --
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc -p packages/hub --noEmit && tsc -p packages/companion --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dashboard --noEmit
